name: Can I fix window air leaks myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix window air leaks myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor air leaks can sometimes be temporarily addressed with DIY solutions like caulk or weatherstripping, professional repair ensures a long-lasting and effective seal. Professionals have the right tools, materials, and expertise to identify hidden leaks and apply proper techniques for maximum energy efficiency. Incorrect DIY repairs can sometimes worsen the problem or provide only short-term relief. For comprehensive and guaranteed results, professional service is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor leaks can be DIY, but professionals offer long-lasting, effective repairs using specialized tools and expertise to ensure maximum energy efficiency and prevent further issues.
